test_suite_name: V3 Python Planet Capture Prepare and Authoritative Verification
description: Prepare a populated planet, verify capture rollback, pause for the actual Python deployment-menu journey, then assert exact PostgreSQL state.

tests.name: Register ordinary Python attacker
Register planet owner
Select non-FedSpace sector without a planet

data.sql: SELECT MIN(s.sector_id) FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id>10 AND s.sector_id<900 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planets p WHERE p.sector_id=s.sector_id);

tests.name: Fund ordinary-player accounts

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=1000000 WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{python_capture_owner_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Set attacker's deterministic personal balance

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=54321 WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{python_capture_attacker_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Set attacker alignment and sector
Set attacker's ship combat fighters

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{py_capture_sector},onplanet=FALSE,fighters=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{python_capture_attacker_player_id});

tests.name: Move planet owner's player record before its active ship
Move planet owner's active ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{py_capture_sector},onplanet=FALSE WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{python_capture_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Pause ambient population growth for exact conservation

data.sql: UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=FALSE WHERE name='planet_growth';

tests.name: Seed populated Python capture target and rollback target

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore,colonists_org,colonists_eq,colonists_weapons,fighters,ore_on_hand,organics_on_hand,equipment_on_hand,created_by,type) SELECT v.planet_id,@{py_capture_sector},v.name,@{python_capture_owner_player_id},'player','M',1000,'COLONIST',600,100,100,100,100,10,123,234,345,@{admin_player_id},(SELECT MIN(planettypes_id) FROM planettypes) FROM (VALUES(977792,'Python Capture Target'),(977793,'Python Capture Rollback')) AS v(planet_id,name) ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id=EXCLUDED.sector_id,name=EXCLUDED.name,owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id,owner_type='player',population=1000,population_type='COLONIST',colonists_unassigned=600,colonists_ore=100,colonists_org=100,colonists_eq=100,colonists_weapons=100,fighters=10,ore_on_hand=123,organics_on_hand=234,equipment_on_hand=345;

tests.name: Seed citadel treasury for both planets

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels(planet_id,level,treasury,owner_id) VALUES(977792,1,456,@{python_capture_owner_player_id}),(977793,1,789,@{python_capture_owner_player_id}) ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=1,treasury=EXCLUDED.treasury,owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Save exact turns for rollback comparison
Install rollback constraint on second target

data.sql: ALTER TABLE planets ADD CONSTRAINT qa_python_capture_rollback CHECK(planet_id<>977793 OR owner_id=@{python_capture_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Injected capture failure is rejected
Injected failure rolls back fighter, turn, population and asset state

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{python_capture_owner_player_id} AND p.population=1000 AND p.population_type='COLONIST' AND p.colonists_unassigned=600 AND p.colonists_ore=100 AND p.colonists_org=100 AND p.colonists_eq=100 AND p.colonists_weapons=100 AND p.fighters=10 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=789 AND s.fighters=100 AND t.turns_remaining=@{py_capture_turns} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type IN('player.capture_planet.v1','player.attack_planet.v1') AND payload LIKE '%977793%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) JOIN players a ON a.player_id=@{python_capture_attacker_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=a.ship_id JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=a.player_id WHERE p.planet_id=977793;

tests.name: Remove rollback constraint after verification

data.sql: ALTER TABLE planets DROP CONSTRAINT qa_python_capture_rollback;

tests.name: Wait for ordinary Python client menu journey
Python capture preserves population, planet resources and both players' balances

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{python_capture_attacker_player_id} AND p.owner_type='player' AND p.population=1000 AND p.population_type='SLAVE' AND p.colonists_unassigned=600 AND p.colonists_ore=100 AND p.colonists_org=100 AND p.colonists_eq=100 AND p.colonists_weapons=100 AND p.fighters=0 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=456 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{python_capture_attacker_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=54321 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{python_capture_owner_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=1000000 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977792%')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) WHERE p.planet_id=977792;

tests.name: Python client fighter count matches the single durable combat event

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.fighters=90 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.attack_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977792%')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{python_capture_attacker_player_id};

tests.name: Python capture session logs out
